stemMd: Three boxes contain, respectively, pens only, pencils only, and a mixture of pens and pencils. Their labels pens, pencils, and mixed are all wrong. One item drawn from the box labelled mixed is a pen. What must that box contain?

options.label: C
options.textMd: A mixture of pens and pencils

explanationMd: Because every label is wrong, the box marked mixed cannot contain a mixture. The drawn pen rules out pencils only. It must contain pens only; no inference about precise quantity is needed.

distractorRationale.e: A pen was drawn from it.
distractorRationale.c: Its mixed label is known to be wrong.
distractorRationale.d: An item was drawn from it.
